scope: MEAS: independent source/order, bar-map, gate arithmetic, overlay and audio-feature review (score-chroma lag test, per-bar chroma test, audio-to-audio DTW of both repeat and return); not aural review.

report.finding: The section's counts, order, gates, endpoint/q388 corrections and page count match the current results, checks and publication. Config SHA-256 70c4a9db… equals results.configSha256; work candidate equals the public score; checks equal results; source downloads and cached audio match their pinned SHA-256 values.

barMap.finding: All 3845 notes lie inside their bar occurrence; bar times strictly increase; 179 printed bars in score, index and SVG data-bar sets; order 1–106, 75–179 = 680 quarters. Rasterised p5.svg shows the repeat-start sign at bar 75 (pp dolce). Listen cues use seconds; their bar mentions agree with the map (57 at 121.60 s, 107 at 261.40 s, 163 at 378.51 s).

independentChecks.tuning: librosa estimate 0.04 semitone = 441.02 Hz, equal to the published tuningHz.
independentChecks.globalLag: Mean framewise cosine between published-score chroma and audio CQT chroma peaks at 0 s lag (0.816), against 0.716/0.693 at ±0.25 s.
independentChecks.perBar: Per-bar cosine median 0.893 at the published bar versus 0.739/0.717 for the neighbouring occurrences; 168 of 211 bars best at zero shift. A ±3-s local shift scan flags only bar 77 occurrence 2 (best −1.1 s, 0.777 vs 0.611); 90.5% of bars have best shift within 0.3 s.
independentChecks.repeat: Audio-to-audio chroma DTW of the first pass of bars 75–106 (150.90–205.04 s) against the second (205.04–261.40 s): path cosine 0.978 against 0.809/0.777 for control regions; published bar times of the two passes agree with the DTW map within median 0.015 s, maximum 0.137 s.
independentChecks.return: Bars 1–56 against 107–162: path cosine 0.979; published bar times agree within median 0.022 s, maximum 0.177 s.

overlays.finding: All six are the fresh 02:40 files listed in results (the seven older 02:37 PNGs in work/ are stale and were not used). The D2/A2 opening is at 2.02 s; the march-to-tranquillo silence lies inside bar 56 and bar 57's G2/D3 enters at 121.60 s; the volta join puts bar 75 occurrence 2 on the B/D-sharp/F-sharp arpeggiated chord at 205.04 s; bar 90 occurrence 2 (middle anchor, 230.01 s) and neighbouring attacks coincide with onset peaks; bar 107's D2/A2 enters at 261.40 s after the post-repeat silence; and the final D1/A1/D2 + D5–D6 chord is at 408.78 s. One small unscored onset near 407.3 s inside bar 178 does not move any bar.

version.finding: The complete piece, with the source's single volta repeat of bars 75–106 and the written-out Tempo I return, matches the recording's order; no cut or extra repeat was found. The Oesterle edition is not claimed as Vetter's actual performing copy.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser run by RevScores. Feature-based checks establish bar-level correspondence, not individual-attack accuracy; the final written hold runs to 413.12 s and is not a measured release.
